# The ALS Association

> The ALS Association is a nonprofit dedicated to finding a cure for ALS while providing comprehensive patient care, support programs, and community engagement opportunities.

The ALS Association leads the fight against amyotrophic lateral sclerosis through research funding, patient services, advocacy, and fundraising initiatives. The organization connects patients, families, and supporters through programs like Walk to Defeat ALS, Team Challenge ALS, and Ride to Defeat ALS, while also providing critical resources like the ALS Insurance Navigator and access to the ALS Nexus Conference.
